## Bounded semantic-kernel checklist

- [ ] `.gooo/semantic.gooo` remains the only semantic authority.
- [ ] Stable semantic IDs and edge IDs are copied, not position-generated.
- [ ] The fixed corpus remains 12 cases with 4 CLOSED / 4 UNKNOWN / 4 REFUTED.
- [ ] The bootstrap oracle remains independent of generated code.
- [ ] The counterexample fixture remains REFUTED.
- [ ] PR Actions are green on Go 1.27 before merge.
- [ ] No local execution is presented as release authority.
